meta.name: military-campaign-authorization
meta.description: Use when authorizing a military campaign or establishing battlefield discipline. Based on the Battle of Gan (甘之战), structures just-cause documentation, formal proclamation (誓), duty assignment, and post-battle accountability at ancestral shrines.

copy.tagline: 起草军事行动授权与战场纪律文书
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为军事行动制定正式授权和纪律规范。
copy.tagline_en: Draft military campaign authorization and battlefield discipline documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create formal authorization and discipline rules for military campaigns.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按甘之战流程：先让你说明敌方罪行作为正义理由，然后发布正式誓词，分配左、右、车夫等职位任务，设定奖惩，最后问责。
howto.when: 当你要求授权军事行动或建立战场纪律时触发。

say.text: 我需要授权一次讨伐，请按流程指导我。
列出敌方违反自然秩序的具体罪行。
say.note: 触发正义理由记录步骤。

say.text: 为我的军队制定战场纪律和奖惩规则。
say.note: 会输出职位分工和后果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows the Battle of Gan procedure: asks for just cause (enemy violations), issues a formal proclamation, assigns duties to positions (left, right, charioteer), sets discipline and consequences, then enforces post-battle accountability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when authorizing a military campaign or establishing battlefield discipline.

say_en.text: I need to authorize a campaign. Guide me through the steps.
say_en.note: Claude will walk through each step.

say_en.text: List the enemy's specific violations of natural order.
say_en.note: Triggers the just cause documentation step.

say_en.text: Set battlefield discipline and reward/punishment rules for my army.
